name: issued-value-with-an-exponent-over-80
violates: spec §2.3: a JSON leaf is the JSON its own bytes decode to; an issued amount's value has one text
notes: Found by a differential run of the two verifiers at code 19a04df5. 1e81 is a value the format can hold (1000000000000000e66). x-data read it and xrpl-py refused it for its written exponent, so the C++ verifier went on to the root check and the Python one stopped at the leaf.

expect.reason_contains: not the JSON its bytes decode to
